summary: All local rows are partitioned into interior and boundary lists and computed on every requested iteration, with halo exchange completed before boundary arithmetic.

source_evidence.claim: Balanced contiguous rank partitions cover all rows. Each row goes to one list, and spmvRows traverses every nonzero in each listed row. Both calls remain inside the CLI-bounded timed loop.

compiled_evidence.claim: Interior multiply/add at cdea/cdf2 and boundary multiply/add at ce8a/ce92 are enclosed by cebe->cbd0, with MPI_Waitall at ce16 between them. Repetition arithmetic is retained.
